phase_order_and_goal.product_path: Install → Provider health → normalize/quality gate → transactional upsert → Canonical DuckDB → Dashboard/K-line → market review → stock analysis → canonical A-share backtest → restart persistence.

second_database_and_frozen_scope.blocker: Contract has no explicit, testable prohibition/compatibility matrix for current per-request mock switches, PostgreSQL admin switch, and K-line DB consumers.

missing_from_pr2_contract: migration source/target table mapping and record-count reconciliation
API-visible data_state/source/quality behavior during and after migration
quality-gate failure behavior and persisted evidence
explicit mock rejection/tagging behavior for every reachable read/write path

transaction_idempotency_rollback.quality_gate_requires: Repeated operations are idempotent, leave no duplicate primary keys, and have post-write verification.

verification_commands.reason: Task explicitly prohibits implementation and acceptance commands during the direction gate.

blocking_issues: PR-2 lacks an explicit migration/data contract covering table mapping, API observability, quality failure semantics, mock handling, transaction idempotency, rollback/resume, and post-write reconciliation.

The declared scope cannot prove removal of existing second-K-line-DB consumers and runtime PostgreSQL/mock escape paths without explicit behavioral acceptance criteria; frozen modules themselves must remain untouched.
conclusion: Do not implement PR-2 until its contract defines the missing machine-verifiable migration and runtime-boundary semantics.
